description: The source is a flat mauve 0x8060a0 -- three channels, all mid-range and all different -- so every knob moves it visibly and none of them moves it by accident. Brightness at 0.2 adds a fifth of the range to every channel: an offset, so all three move by the same 51 rather than by a fifth of themselves. A build multiplying instead would move them by different amounts and change the hue.
